text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, uh-huh... oh-ho. There's even a 
method like this... mhm, mhm.

As I was about to enter the trainer's 
office, I heard Aston Machan talking to 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. You're here early.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I'm all ready. Let's 
hurry up and get to training~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City, I saw your new cosmetics commercial! 
Seriously, it was insane. Your signature 
look is unmatched.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "In an instant, seize it."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, I'm not the one saying that. The 
narration is a totally different person.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ……Hmph, there.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, I got some top-notch scoops for ya. 
How 'bout it? Wanna know what the biker 
world's like?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Those spots are hard for 
Chan-Mei to reach, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, I won't let you pry any 
deeper. Not even if you're my Trainer, got 
it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup. Please go ahead and head back 
first, Trainer.

I frequently caught her acting 
mysteriously after that... but she 
stubbornly refused to tell me what she was 
doing.

However, just as I finished my work and 
was about to leave the Trainer's Office...

The notebook that Aston Machan always kept 
by her side is lying on the table. Did she 
leave it behind? Should I return it to 
her?
...Yooouuuu saw that, didn't youuu?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A wild Machan appears! Surprised? You're 
totally surprised, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But it couldn't be helped. I accidentally 
saw Chan-chan's SSB that she left behind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: SSB. It stands for "Super Secret Book."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, it's also an abbreviation for 
"Future Commercial Strategy Book." Don't 
call it sloppy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Researching sales strategies... In other 
words, this is a research book on Chan-Me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm compiling what kind of topics are 
trending across commercials, catchphrases, 
and even circles we don't usually interact 
with.
choice_data_list: In that case, you don't have to hide it...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Information leaks are fatal to marketing 
strategies. They significantly diminish 
the entertainment value.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, my secret's out now. Good 
grief...”
choice_data_list: ...By the way, I haven't seen it yet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then that means Chan-Me has confessed her 
secret. Isn't that terribly clumsy of me?

Aston Machan often behaves in strange 
ways, but in truth, her motives might 
simply be pure and full of hard work...
choice_data_list: I won't tell anyone about the research.

Let me help you improve your promotion 
skills.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nnn, what kindness. I feel like I've 
gained an unexpected ally.
choice_data_list:
I've been on your side from the very 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true. Now that you mention it, 
you're right."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's share the contents with 
our allies. The presentation will now 
begin.

Afterward, Aston Machan held a promotional 
research presentation, delivered in her 
uniquely distinctive cadence.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Two are better than one. And three are 
better than two... Hmm."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"However, are you sure it's alright? 
Aren't you busy?"
choice_data_list:
Because I want to achieve results worthy 
of the effort.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"……Hearing it called 'hard work' like that 
makes me feel a bit ticklish, honestly."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since we have the chance, 
please do. Operation: Level Up Machan's 
Mascot Skills is underway!
